export declare function fillPromptCommand(command: {
    readonly text: string;
    readonly takes_arguments: boolean;
}, words: string): string;

export declare function mergePromptCommands<Command extends PromptCommandFile>(...lists: readonly (readonly Command[])[]): Command[];

export declare function promptCommandName(path: string): string | null;

export declare function readPromptCommand(file: {
    readonly location: PromptCommandLocation;
    readonly path: string;
    readonly text: string | null;
    readonly bytes: number;
}): PromptCommandFile | null;
